guards.rule: Only current exact recipient primary authentication plus proof of original enrollment holder key permits transport recovery. Operator cannot replace recipient/holder; lost original holder key routes support/hold, no substitute from social login alone. No keys exported or mnemonic imported in this flow.

Immutable original AdmissionContext, permit digests, rental/binding/account/device and epoch stay fixed. Continuation lease is additional signed authorization of transport generation/session, not replacement AdmissionPermit/ActivationPermit. Firmware and server must adopt the paired adapter; old firmware must not accept original permits outside their original live session.

ER01 sender proof binds current account, original holder, method/path/admissionId/request digest and client nonce. Server authenticates current consent/scope/profile, reserves one continuation per admission+predecessor generation under same device/authority gates, returns original lineage on retries. Different keys cannot allocate competing successors; unresolved continuation never expires into a free generation.

ERB01 verifies server-signed challenge and original holder key thumbprint/proof, exact original admission/epoch/binding and device identity. Under device lock create durable resume-prepared record, invalidate old enrollment transport and persist new generation intent before returning signed proof with fresh boot/device/client nonces and intended new session. Only this one prepared lineage proceeds; crash/unknown history holds enrollment. No stage/activate during resume-prepared.

ER02 verifies device resume proof + current owner/holder/consent/current revisions, then reserves immutable ContinuationLease in same lineage; signer completion rechecks current predicates. Lease binds original context digest, exact generation successor, prepared proof digest/boot/nonces/new session/expiry/purpose. ERB02 applies only same durable prepared state, persists generation/session and immutable receipt before exposing continuation; old sessions and mismatched leases rejected.

ER03 verifies exact device applied receipt and current lineage then confirms server generation, work and outcome atomically. Until confirmed, server-dependent enrollment stage/activation submissions are blocked. Local application can precede server receipt, so uncertainty keeps exclusive original admission. Reboot after prepare/apply never infers ready; selected profile defines durable generation and live session freshness. Expired continuation cannot silently advance generation; same pending lineage stays held for authorized recovery.

Each stage/activate request carries original immutable permit plus current continuation lease where resumed; verify original holder proof on this transport, exact persisted device generation, session/boot and original binding context. No mutation of original consent/proof refs; server records used continuation generation on resulting evidence/outcome. Protocol/version transition must reject legacy bearer replay; already exposed old permit may have executed before invalidation, record uncertainty.

ER04 records technical enrollment authorization withdrawal for the exact recipient/admission, atomically advances consent authorization revision and holds future enrollment/resume/signature delivery; preserves historical consumed consent and reservation. Does not revoke completed wallet ownership, blockchain signatures, privacy consent or all device functions. No automatic deletion, reset, reassignment or refund. Other domain consents separate.

Withdrawal wins vs API045/resume/activation at shared authority+invitation/device/consent gates. Before reservation EB05 remains applicable; after reservation ER04 records withdrawal irrespective of prior device receipt. Already-issued permits/continuation leases may have acted offline; server cannot promise recall. A signed enrollment-only HoldInstruction may be delivered; applied device proof confirms enrollment mutation fence, not wipe or rollback.

ERB03 hold instruction uses monotonic consent revision, exact account/admission/binding/device epoch and scope enrollment_mutations_only. Device journals hold before ACK, blocks stage/activate/resume for that lineage, preserves wallet/use ownership and recovery evidence. Does not erase current generation or falsely revert activated binding. Newer epoch/new admission does not accept old hold. Device hold receipt reports observed enrollment phase for reconciliation, never invents server phase.

ER03 withdrawal_hold receipt may be relayed by exact recipient or currently scoped operator with only submit_hold_evidence capability; continuation_applied requires recipient+original holder. Operator does not gain resume/activation/withdrawal issuance authority. GET ER05 current parent ACL, only safe status to operator; raw lease/hold instruction only separately authorized exact recipient or scoped hold-delivery operator for hold only.

Missing device after withdrawal remains device_execution_unknown; rental/basis remain consumed/reserved. Active rental needs original return checks/owner proofs; uncertain or staged admission must be reconciled under explicit reset/return support contract before inventory reuse. Same user cannot merely toggle withdrawn to active; renewed enrollment consent/recovery is a separate unadopted decision, no automatic reactivation.

Registry/writes form one enforceable SQL transaction domain with lifecycle heads and approval_authorization_gates. Gate list recomputed after locks; missing rows use parent scope lock and unique constraint. No split-store eventual consistency for consumption, generation or withdrawal. Existing 61-table/7-migration SQL untouched; new table types/nullable/durable fields are proposals.

Current crypto/firmware tuple must explicitly support immutable permit+continuation, consent-revision holds and protected generation storage. Unknown/old profile fails closed; BLE capability negotiation is not trust proof. No automatic downgrade to original enrollment bearer/owner session. Profile selection and device tests remain unperformed.

Withdrawal locks shared device/invitation/consent/authority scopes but mutates an enrollment-action-specific authorization gate; never set a global wallet/device deny merely from enrollment withdrawal. Device hold applies only to stage/activate/resume of exact lineage. Active binding stays active; continuation after active may reconcile original receipts only, cannot restage/recreate wallet or transfer ownership.
